steps.name: Test original Objective Session retention and one-shot transport adapter

steps.name: Verify original shared presenter source and default-off candidate
steps.original_run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10"
python3 -I -B tests/ui/test_shared_presenter_source.py \
  2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-source-tests.log"
python3 -I -B tests/ui/test_wire_compatibility.py \
  2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/wire-compatibility-tests.log"
cargo metadata --manifest-path ui/Cargo.toml --locked --format-version 1 \
  --features trill-shell/hepta-shared-presenter \
  --filter-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-metadata.json"

  --metadata "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-metadata.json" \

steps.name: Test original shared packages and real egui edit transactions
steps.original_run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --manifest-path ui/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked \
  -p hepta-control-core -p hepta-robrix-ui -p trill-ui-core -p trill-shell \
  --no-default-features --features trill-shell/hepta-shared-presenter \
  2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-tests.log"
cargo clippy --manifest-path ui/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked \
  -p trill-ui-core -p trill-shell \
  --features trill-shell/hepta-shared-presenter -- -D warnings \
  2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-clippy.log"
cargo run --quiet --manifest-path ui/Cargo.toml --locked \
  -p trill-ui-core --example wire_compatibility --no-default-features \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-wire-default.json"
cmp tests/ui/wire-compatibility-aligned-v1.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-wire-default.json"
python3 -I -B tests/ui/verify_wire_compatibility.py \
  --original tests/ui/wire-compatibility-v1.json \
  --candidate "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-wire-default.json" \
  | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/wire-default-compatibility.json"
cargo run --quiet --manifest-path ui/Cargo.toml --locked \
  -p trill-ui-core --example wire_compatibility \
  --features hepta-shared-presenter \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-wire.json"
cmp tests/ui/wire-compatibility-aligned-v1.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-wire.json"
python3 -I -B tests/ui/verify_wire_compatibility.py \
  --original tests/ui/wire-compatibility-v1.json \
  --candidate "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-wire.json" \
  | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/wire-candidate-compatibility.json"

  --metadata "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-metadata.json" \
  2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/a10/shared-presenter-source-after-tests.log"

steps.name: Enforce committed UI dependency lock after attempting real tests
steps.original_run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ ! -s ui/Cargo.lock ]] || ! git ls-files --error-unmatch ui/Cargo.lock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'A10 Cargo.lock is absent/untracked: host success is not reproducible.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git diff --exit-code HEAD -- ui/Cargo.lock
sha256sum ui/Cargo.lock
cargo metadata --manifest-path ui/Cargo.toml --locked --offline --format-version 1 >/dev/null
